title: AI Custom Instructions Character Limits (2026 Cheat Sheet)
description: Verified 2026 character and byte limits for ChatGPT custom instructions (1,500 chars), Codex AGENTS.md (32 KiB), Claude, Meta Muse, and Grok.
h1: AI custom instructions character limits (2026 cheat sheet).
dek: Exact field lengths, byte caps, and file paths across ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex, Claude, Claude Code, Meta Muse, Gemini, Cursor, and Grok.
lede: Nothing breaks a personality tuning faster than silent truncation. ChatGPT's account custom instructions cap each longer field at 1,500 characters, while OpenAI Codex caps the entire merged AGENTS.md chain at 32 KiB (32,768 bytes) via project_doc_max_bytes. Here is the complete reference table of documented limits and how to fit your communication rules inside each one.
answer: ChatGPT's longer Custom Instructions fields are documented at 1,500 characters each. OpenAI Codex caps combined AGENTS.md files at 32 KiB (32,768 bytes, set by project_doc_max_bytes). Claude Personal Preferences, Claude Projects, Claude Code output styles, Meta Muse Soul.md, and Gemini Gems accept full multi-paragraph Markdown blocks without a 1,500-character cliff, though keeping rules under 1,200 characters improves instruction adherence.

sections.h2: Why shorter tunings beat 10,000-word prompt walls.
sections.html:
Even on surfaces that accept large Markdown files, stuffing thousands of words of personality lore into your global instructions hurts performance for three reasons:

  1. Instruction dilution: Every rule you add competes for attention with your actual task prompt and with the rules that matter most.
  2. Over-literal compliance in newer reasoning models: As OpenAI noted in its developer guidance for GPT-6 Astra, newer models listen much harder to system and AGENTS.md instructions than earlier generations did. Forceful, all-caps boundary paragraphs written for older models cause modern agents to halt early or over-apply a formatting rule where it does not belong.
  3. Silent byte-cap truncation in monorepos: In OpenAI Codex, the 32 KiB project_doc_max_bytes limit is shared across your global ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, the repo root AGENTS.md, and any nested folder AGENTS.md. A compact 700-byte personal tuning leaves over 97% of the budget free for repository build and test instructions.

sections.h2: A universal 580-character tuning block that fits every platform.
sections.html:
This reviewed block is 580 characters (well under ChatGPT's 1,500-character cap and less than 2% of Codex's 32 KiB budget). Paste it anywhere:

## Communication preferences - Lead with the direct answer, conclusion, or recommendation in the first sentence. - Match length to complexity; keep routine replies under 150 words. - Use plain prose by default. Add bullet lists or tables only when comparing three or more items. - Skip throat-clearing openers, flattery, and "let me know if you need anything else" closers. - Push back directly when an assumption in my prompt is mistaken, and state why. - Separate verified facts from inferences and flag material uncertainty in one line.

Need a version tailored to your own personality profile? Open the Custom Instructions Generator or pick any of the 43 profiles in the library and select ChatGPT · custom instructions for an automatic under-1,500-character export.

faq.q: What is the character limit for ChatGPT Custom Instructions in 2026?
faq.a: OpenAI documents a 1,500-character limit for the longer Custom Instructions fields under Settings, Personalization, Custom Instructions. Every profile in AgentTune includes a reviewed compact export under 1,500 characters.

faq.q: What is the byte limit for OpenAI Codex AGENTS.md?
faq.a: Codex reads up to 32 KiB (32,768 bytes) combined across all AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md files in the directory chain, configured by project_doc_max_bytes.

faq.q: Do ChatGPT Project Instructions have the same 1,500-character limit?
faq.a: No. Project Instructions inside a ChatGPT Project accept full multi-paragraph Markdown tunings and override your global Custom Instructions inside that project.

faq.q: How many rules should I put in Claude Personal Preferences or Meta Muse Soul.md?
faq.a: Six to ten clear bullet points (roughly 500 to 1,200 characters) cover tone, answer order, formatting, and pushback without crowding out your task context.
